objective: Optimize b13 top candidates toward thresholds. KEY INSIGHT: z60 boosted conf_low 2Y from 0.07 to 0.39 (5.6x). If z60 boosts FLIP -snt21_2pos_std 2Y=0.78 similarly, 2Y could exceed 1.0. Also test new FLIP field (neut_std), ts_rank with longer window to reduce tvr, and z30 for asi_jpn.

b13_reference.best_2Y: expr8 Jjv60JWW conf_low ts_rank30 z40: 2Y1.02 but tvr0.44 (too high)

design.expr1_flip_pos_std_z60: FLIP -snt21_2pos_std + z60. HIGHEST PRIORITY. z60 2Y boost (5.6x for conf_low). If 2Y 0.78*5.6=4.4 (unlikely that strong, but even 2x=1.56 close to 1.6 threshold). Expected: sh~0.70-0.76, 2Y~1.0-1.5.
design.expr2_neg_max_z60: neg_max + z60. Best sh field (0.75) + 2Y-boosting window. conf_low z60 gave 2Y=0.39. neg_max z40 gave 2Y=0.26. With z60, 2Y could reach ~0.5+.
design.expr3_flip_neut_std_z40: FLIP -snt21_2neut_std + z40. NEW flip field. b12 snt21_2neut_std sh-0.54 (reversed). Flip expected sh~0.54. Different signal (neutral sentiment vol vs positive). Tests if all sentiment std flips work.
design.expr4_flip_neut_std_z60: FLIP -snt21_2neut_std + z60. New flip + 2Y boost. If flip gives sh~0.54 and z60 boosts 2Y, could be competitive.
design.expr5_flip_pos_std_z30: FLIP -snt21_2pos_std + z30. z30 was best for asi_jpn in b10/b11. Tests if asi_jpn improves for flip signal.
design.expr6_neg_max_z30: neg_max + z30. asi_jpn test for best sh field.
design.expr7_ts_rank_neg_max_60: ts_rank(neg_max, 60) + z40. b13 ts_rank(conf_low, 30) had 2Y=1.02 but tvr=0.44. Longer window (60 vs 30) should reduce tvr. neg_max is stronger field than conf_low. If tvr drops below 30% and 2Y stays >1.0, could be viable.
design.expr8_flip_pos_std_mean40_z40: FLIP -snt21_2pos_std + ts_mean(40) + z40. Longer smoothing (40 vs 20 days). May boost sh by reducing noise. Trades responsiveness for stability.

field_verification.snt21_2pos_std: Confirmed ASI in b12 (sh-0.74) and b13 (FLIP sh0.76)
field_verification.snt23_2neg_max: Confirmed ASI in b13 (sh0.75, ASI datafield query coverage 0.6828, 20 users)

expectations.expr1_z60_breakthrough: If z60 boosts 2Y for FLIP pos_std like it did for conf_low (5.6x), 2Y could go from 0.78 to >1.0. This is the most promising expression.
expectations.expr7_ts_rank_tvr: ts_rank(60) should have lower tvr than ts_rank(30)=0.44. Target: tvr<0.30. If 2Y stays >1.0, this could be a unique viable alpha.
expectations.expr3_4_neut_flip: If neut_std flip works like pos_std flip, adds another signal type. sh~0.54 expected.
